programme.title: IP MAN 1 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]

programme.title: The Divine Fury [English Dub]

programme.title: A Man of Reason [English Dub]
programme.desc: After 10 years in the prison on behalf of his boss, Soo-hyuk is released, but the boss doubts his loyalty. When Soo-hyuk visits his long-abandoned girlfriend, he finds out that he, now, is a father of young girl. He wants to cut ties with the gang, but the boss is not ready to release him, and hires a notorious killer. The killer takes the daughter as hostage, and Soo-hyuk decides to take revenge in a way that he's best at; violence.

programme.title: Inside Men [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A politician and a wealthy CEO scheme with a reputable journalist to create slush fund and to manipulate public opinion. They use Ahn Sang-gu, a gangster deeply involved in politics, to manage their slush fund, but Ahn Sang-gu gets caught and as a result is abandoned. Sang-gu is bent on having his revenge. On the other hand, Woo Jang-hoon, a prosecutor without any powerful friends, is desperate to solve the slush fund case so he can get a promotion.

programme.title: HARBIN [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In 1909, a Korean freedom fighter plots to assassinate Japan's prime minister on a train journey to Harbin, seeking redemption for his fallen squad.

programme.title: The Man Standing Next [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: October 26th, 1979, Kim Gyu-pyeong, the director of KCIA, shoots President Park at his safe house. Forty days before the incident, Park Yong-gak, the former KCIA director, disclose the president's corruption. The Pres. wants to "take care of" Park after discovering he wrote a memoir, and Kim volunteers to persuade him. Kim asks Park to hand over the documents and asks forgiveness, but Park refuses, saying, "He doesn't let the No. 2 alive." Kwak Sang-chun, the head of the president's security team, expresses his loyalty to the president excessively, which makes the conflict between Kwak and Kim. When the memoir publishes in Japan, the president reprimands Kim. Kim executes a mission that proves his loyalty to the president, but the president's trust falters more.

programme.title: KUNG FU KILLER [English Dub]
programme.desc: A martial arts instructor from the police force gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.

programme.title: The Pirates [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: On the eve of the founding of Joseon Dynasty, the ship of the envoy clashes with a whale, and Ming Emperor's Seal of State was swallowed by the whale. The government promises generous prize to whoever recovers the Seal. Everyone who eyes on the money comes to the sea. Among them, there is a group of bandits, led by Jang Sa-jung, a former soldier who denied the new dynasty. Meanwhile, the government frames the pirates responsible for the Seal's missing. Commanded by Yeo-wol, the pirate try to recover it, to prove the innocence.

programme.title: Lost In Thailand [English Subtitle]

programme.title: Escape from the 21st Century [English Dub]

programme.title: Exhuma [English Dub]
